page_title: FUL 2-1 NOT | Fulham v Nottingham Forest 15/02/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's the end of the match.
90+5' Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery.
90+2' A quickly taken corner by Fulham.
90+1' Matz Sels pulls off a great save to deny Rodrigo Muniz (Fulham), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick shot towards the middle of the goal.
90' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Adama Traore as he is replaced by Ryan Sessegnon (Fulham).
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
90' Marco Silva has decided to make a change. Willian (Fulham) replaces Alex Iwobi.
88' Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
88' A dangerous looking corner kick from Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) is cleared to safety by the defence.
85' It's time for a substitution. Jota Silva (Nottingham) comes on in place of Elliot Anderson.
83' The manager makes a subsitution with Harrison Reed (Fulham) coming on for Sasa Lukic.
83' Marco Silva has decided to substitute Emile Smith Rowe and he is replaced by Andreas Pereira (Fulham).
82' Sasa Lukic (Fulham) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
79' Sasa Lukic (Fulham) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
78' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger. The referee blows his whistle, Fulham are awarded a corner kick.

77' Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham) latches on to a precise pass and one-on-one with the keeper slams the ball towards the right-hand post. Bernd Leno is alert, though, and leaps like a salmon to deny him.
76' Here is a change. Raul Jimenez is going off and Marco Silva gives the last tactical orders to Rodrigo Muniz (Fulham).
76' Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) plants a nice towering header goalwards, but one of the defenders is in the right place at the right time and makes a vital clearance.
74' Emile Smith Rowe (Fulham) misses a sitter from inside the six-yard box after striking the ball narrowly wide of the goal.
69' Nottingham take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
68' Nuno Espirito Santo prepares a substitution. Morato is replaced by Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham).
66' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Sasa Lukic (Fulham), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
63' The referee signals a substitution. Ibrahim Sangare (Nottingham) is brought on as a substitute for Danilo.
62' 2 - 1 GOAL! The corner comes over and Raul Jimenez wins a simple header before Calvin Bassey (Fulham) nods the ball into the back of the net. 2:1.
62' Good work from Fulham as they win a corner.

61' A sweeping move ends with a pass to Sasa Lukic (Fulham) inside the box. He lets fly towards the bottom right corner, but Matz Sels was watching it all the way and makes a comfortable save. The linesman makes the right call and Fulham will have a corner.
61' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition.
59' The resulting corner from Sasa Lukic (Fulham) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.

58' What a chance! Adama Traore (Fulham) gets on the end of a pass inside the box and takes a shot to the bottom right corner, but one of the defending players makes a crucial goal-line clearance. Fulham force their opponents to concede a corner.
56' Sasa Lukic (Fulham) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
54' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Neco Williams (Nottingham).
52' Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
50' Timothy Castagne (Fulham) fires a shot high over the bar from inside the box after latching onto a short pass.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+2' The end of the first half.
45+1' Raul Jimenez (Fulham) does well to control a poor pass on the edge of the box then shoots towards the bottom right corner. Matz Sels is out of position but leaps to make a brilliant save.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
43' A cross from a corner kick by Nottingham is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
42' Neco Williams (Nottingham) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball is out of play and Nottingham manage to earn a corner.
41' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) volleys the ball on the edge of the box after a rebound. It's a great effort and has Matz Sels scrambling, but it flies just over the bar.
41' Sasa Lukic (Fulham) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
37' 1 - 1 Spectacular goal! Chris Wood (Nottingham) brilliantly darts into the box to latch on to a cross and buries the ball into the bottom left corner, leaving the goalkeeper stunned!
36' Emile Smith Rowe (Fulham) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender.
33' Sasa Lukic (Fulham) latches onto a lofted pass near the penalty spot only to head the ball yards wide of the left post.
31' Sasa Lukic (Fulham) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
29' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Adama Traore (Fulham), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.

26' What a save from Matz Sels! Raul Jimenez (Fulham) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising header from close range towards the roof of the net, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant save to keep it out.
22' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
20' Sander Berge (Fulham) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.

15' 1 - 0 It's a goal! Emile Smith Rowe (Fulham) bursts into the box to get on the end of a whipped in cross from Adama Traore and scores magnificently from close range into the left side of the goal. 1:0.

12' Chance! Adama Traore sends a brilliant curling cross into the heart of the defence and into the path of Raul Jimenez (Fulham), whose header from the centre of the box goes a whisker wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Nottingham will have a goal kick.
11' Chance! Neco Williams (Nottingham) took a nice pass in his stride in the box, but scuffed his shot just wide of the left post.
10' Adama Traore (Fulham) commits a rough foul. Thomas Bramall stops the game and makes a call.
4' Emile Smith Rowe (Fulham) performs a sliding tackle but catches his opponent's legs. The referee blows his whistle for an infringement.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Fulham will kick-off.
Thomas Bramall is introduced as the referee for today's match.
